plugins.name: risk-management
plugins.description: The risk-management role on contract v3 (issue-160 round-3 promotion). Decides: 전사 리스크 노출이 허용 범위인가.

plugins.name: erm-verdict-methodology
plugins.description: Enforces ISO 31000:2018 process-clause shape (6.3-6.6) on erm-verdict facet documents. Composes into risk-management's phase-1 and phase-2 norms (issue-7).

plugins.name: risk-register-methodology
plugins.description: Enforces the ISO 31000 risk-register 12-field schema with per-field judgment criteria on risk-register-entry facet documents. Composes into risk-management's phase-1 and phase-2 norms (issue-7).

plugins.name: phase1-proposal-norms
plugins.description: Role-agnostic 기획서(phase-1) proposal writing norm: survey-before-proposal ordering, explicit phase-gate statement, canon-reference-only discipline (issue-7).

plugins.name: phase2-record-norms
plugins.description: Role-agnostic 산출물(phase-2) record writing norm: record must backlink the phase-1 proposal it implements (issue-7).
